name: Systems Under Pressure Tutorial Script
description: Step-by-step guidance for the advanced tutorial about system coupling, collapse, and Consult.

steps.title: A Realm in Peril
steps.message: This domain is wounded — its foundations crumble and the team is stretched thin. When the vials drop below their critical marks, the system enters collapse and weakens everything you do. Study the vials: your challenge begins here.

steps.title: A Tempting Shortcut
steps.message: Sometimes you must deliver despite a crumbling system. Play Push Through the Crunch from your hand — it wins the council's favor but exhausts the team and damages system health. Watch the vials when they cross their critical marks.

steps.title: The Curse of Coupling
steps.message: Team Capacity and System Health have both fallen below their critical marks — the system is in collapse. When a vial collapses, positive gains to coupled vials are diminished. The system's rot drags the rest of the table down with it.

steps.title: Search the Grimoire
steps.message: Your hand already holds recovery pages — Rally the Guild and Stabilize the System can lift the storm. Deep Refactor would dig the pit deeper. Consult the Archives: set Deep Refactor aside and pull Rest the Team from the Grimoire. Searching costs the turn. The system keeps moving while you look.

steps.title: Breaking the Curse
steps.message: Rest the Team is now in your hand. Play it. It will not dazzle the council, but it lifts Team Capacity out of collapse so later pages recover at full strength.

steps.title: Mend the Foundation
steps.message: Capacity is breathing again. System Health is still in collapse. Play Rally the Guild — it lifts health and capacity together, now that coupling no longer steals the gain.

steps.title: Trial by Fire Complete!
steps.message: You have seen collapse, coupling, and Consult. The hand is never the whole library — searching the Grimoire costs a turn, and waiting is a decision the system will charge you for. Onward, Architect!
